name: Armin Soyka
testimonial: Johannes was one of the most technically capable and reliable engineers I've worked with. What stood out wasn't just his skill, but his judgment — I found myself consulting him on architecture decisions, team situations, and engineering trade-offs well beyond his immediate scope. He has a rare ability to take on genuinely complex problems and return with solutions that are both elegant and practical. I'd work with him again without hesitation.
project: Enterprise Platform Migration, Customer Support Automation, Biomechanical Analysis

name: Ofer Plesser
testimonial: I brought Johannes on to help build materials for a cybersecurity training course. After a couple of quick rounds of feedback early on, I could basically hand him work and let him run with it. What came back was consistently good, with almost nothing to correct. Our calls were short, his pricing was fair, and a few times he didn't charge me for things that were small mistakes on his end. He's also just a genuinely interesting person... there's more to him than the technical side, and you feel it in how he thinks through things.
